alt: Poster: Sensex 82,532.19 (+0.52%), Nifty 50 25,387.40 (+0.38%), Nifty PSU Bank +1.95% on 17 Nov 2026
text:
Benchmarks rose again on Tuesday, with public sector banks leading.

• Sensex closed at 82,532.19, up 427.40 points (0.52%); Nifty 50 closed at 25,387.40, up 96.30 points (0.38%), per exchange data as reported by Upstox and Kotak Neo.
• Nifty PSU Bank gained about 1.95% and Nifty Auto about 0.7%, per Kotak Neo and Upstox closing reports.
• Brent crude traded around $92.7 per barrel in the afternoon, per Kotak Neo and Upstox.
• Nifty IT and several large-cap names outside banking and autos closed lower, so the gains were not uniform across sectors.

Our view: a session led by one group of sectors is a reminder that benchmark gains can hide uneven participation underneath. We read this as a one-day observation about leadership, not a trend, and it may or may not persist. This is an interpretation, not a prediction or advice.

For practitioners: when gains are led by a single sector, what do you look at to judge how broad a rally really is?
